cast_audio_unsupported.label: Sendspin isn't supported on this Cast device. Use the standard Cast protocol instead.

sendspin_static_delay.label: Static playback delay (ms)
sendspin_static_delay.description: Offset in milliseconds to keep this player in sync with other players. Increase if audio plays too late, for example to compensate for latency from an amp, active speakers, or the OS.

preferred_sendspin_format.label: Preferred audio format
preferred_sendspin_format.description: Select the audio format to use for playback on this player.

allow_unencrypted.label: Allow unencrypted connections
allow_unencrypted.description: Accept legacy Sendspin clients that do not support encryption. Unencrypted connections are not authenticated and can be intercepted on the local network. This is also (currently) required for the built-in web player.

min_pin_length.label: Minimum PIN length
min_pin_length.description: Minimum number of digits for dynamic PIN pairing.

security_status_disconnected.label: The device disconnected and will reappear once it reconnects.

security_status_unencrypted.label: This device is connected without encryption (legacy mode). Pairing is not available.

security_status_paired.label: This device is paired. The connection is encrypted and authenticated.

security_status_unpaired.label: The connection is encrypted, but the device is not securely paired.

pairing_error_concurrent.label: Another pairing attempt is already in progress.

pairing_error_locked_out.label: PIN pairing is locked out on the device.

pairing_error_method_unsupported.label: The device does not support this pairing method.

pairing_error_pin_length.label: The device rejected the PIN length.

pairing_error_pin_mismatch.label: The PIN did not match. Please try again.

pairing_error_cancelled.label: Pairing was cancelled on the device.

pairing_error_handshake.label: The secure connection to the device failed during pairing. Please try again.

pairing_error_no_pin_session.label: No PIN pairing is in progress.

pairing_error_no_pin_method.label: The device does not offer PIN pairing.

pairing_error_token_invalid.label: The pairing token is not valid. Make sure it was copied completely.

pairing_error_token_mismatch.label: The token was issued by a different device.

pairing_pin_prompt_gesture.label: Put the device in pairing mode, then enter its PIN.

pairing_pin_progress_gesture.label: PIN received. Put the device in pairing mode to finish pairing.

pairing_pin_progress.label: Pairing is in progress. Check back in a moment.

verify_pin_start.label: Verify device presence
verify_pin_start.description: Confirm this is the physical device in front of you by entering its dynamic PIN. Briefly interrupts playback.

unpair.label: Unpair
unpair.description: Remove the pairing with this device. Both sides forget the stored credential and the device reconnects as unpaired.

allow_unpaired.label: Allow playback without pairing
allow_unpaired.description: Let this device play audio without being paired. Warning: unpaired connections are encrypted but not authenticated and can be intercepted (man-in-the-middle) on the local network.

revoke_unpaired.label: Revoke playback without pairing
revoke_unpaired.description: Stop allowing this device to play audio without pairing.

management_enter.label: Manage device settings
management_enter.description: Change the device's own pairing settings. While the management section is open, the device rejects connections from other servers.

management_status.label: Managing device settings. The device rejects other servers until this section is closed.

management_unpaired_enable.label: Enable unpaired access
management_unpaired_enable.description: Let the device accept connections from servers without pairing. Unpaired connections are encrypted but not authenticated.

management_unpaired_disable.label: Disable unpaired access
management_unpaired_disable.description: Stop the device from accepting connections from servers that are not paired with it.

management_static_pin_enable.label: Enable static PIN pairing
management_static_pin_enable.description: Let the device accept new pairings using its static PIN.

management_static_pin_disable.label: Disable static PIN pairing
management_static_pin_disable.description: Stop the device from accepting new pairings using its static PIN.

management_dynamic_pin_enable.label: Enable dynamic PIN pairing
management_dynamic_pin_enable.description: Let the device accept new pairings using a dynamic PIN it provides while pairing.

management_dynamic_pin_disable.label: Disable dynamic PIN pairing
management_dynamic_pin_disable.description: Stop the device from accepting new pairings using a dynamic PIN it provides while pairing.

management_error_permission_denied.label: The device refused the management request.

management_error_already_exists.label: The entry already exists on the device.

management_error_invalid.label: The device rejected the request as invalid.

management_error_not_found.label: The entry does not exist on the device.

management_error_storage_exhausted.label: The device is out of storage space.

management_error_timeout.label: The device did not respond in time.

management_error_no_session.label: No management session is open for this device.

select_method.title: Pair this device
select_method.description: Choose how to pair with this device. PIN pairing uses a code the device shows while pairing (or a static PIN printed on it); token pairing uses a pairing token you copy from the device.

awaiting_gesture.title: Put the device in pairing mode
awaiting_gesture.description: Put the device in pairing mode so it can show its PIN. This briefly interrupts playback on the device.
awaiting_gesture.progress_text: Waiting for the device to enter pairing mode...

enter_pin.title: Enter the PIN
enter_pin.description: Enter the PIN shown on (or printed on) the device to finish pairing.

confirming.title: Finishing pairing
confirming.description: Completing the secure pairing with the device.

enter_token.title: Enter the pairing token
enter_token.description: Paste the device's pairing token to pair it. This briefly interrupts playback on the device.

abort.nothing_to_configure: This player has nothing to pair. Bridge and web players, and devices connected without encryption, do not require pairing.
abort.no_pair_methods: The device does not offer any pairing method.
abort.pairing_error_locked_out: PIN pairing is locked out on the device. Wait a moment, then try again from the device's settings.
abort.pairing_error_not_connected: The device is no longer connected.
abort.pairing_failed: Pairing with the device failed. Please try again.

manifest.description: Sendspin is an audio playback, control and synchronization protocol developed by the Open Home Foundation and is the native playback protocol built into Music Assistant, used for playback to supported clients like the Music Assistant Web interface, supported (mobile) clients and supported hardware

errors.cast_app_not_ready: Cast app on {0} did not report ready within 30 seconds.
errors.cast_app_members_not_ready: Cast app on {0} did not report ready within 30 seconds.

errors.pairing_error_pin_length: The device rejected the PIN length.
errors.pairing_error_cancelled: Pairing was cancelled on the device.
errors.pairing_error_method_unsupported: The device does not support this pairing method.
errors.pairing_error_aborted: The device aborted the pairing attempt.
